Leave required fields blank and click Test.

bugs.name: PagerTree notification saves with blank required Integration URL
bugs.summary: Saving a PagerTree notification with its visibly asterisk-marked Integration URL blank closes the dialog and adds the named notification to the list.
bugs.expected: The asterisk-marked Integration URL is required, so saving it blank should keep the dialog open and prevent adding the notification.
bugs.actual: After Save, the dialog closed, a Saved confirmation appeared, and the notification list showed mo-uptime-kuma-04-notifications-pagertree-empty-save-20260622-7f2d despite the Integration URL being empty.
reproSteps: Sign in as the fixture admin and open Settings > Notifications > Set Up Notification > PagerTree.
Give the notification a unique disposable Friendly Name and leave the asterisk-marked Integration URL blank.
Click Save. Observe a Saved confirmation and a new notification list row despite the missing required URL.

bugs.name: LunaSea notification saves with required User ID empty
bugs.summary: LunaSea saves successfully with its starred User ID left blank, and reopening the saved notification shows the required field still empty.
bugs.expected: Saving a LunaSea notification without its required User ID should be blocked by validation, and the incomplete configuration should not appear in the notification list.
bugs.actual: Save closed the form and showed a green “Saved.” confirmation; the notification appeared in the list. Opening Edit showed the starred User ID field empty.
reproSteps: As the authenticated admin, open /settings/notifications using the supplied authenticated session; no credentials were entered or changed.
Click Set Up Notification and select LunaSea.
Set Friendly Name to nt-push-lunasea-validation and Target to User ID. Leave the starred User ID field empty, keep Default enabled on, and leave Apply on all existing monitors off.
Click Save. Observe the form close, the “Saved.” confirmation, and the new notification in the list.
Open Edit for nt-push-lunasea-validation and observe that the starred User ID field remains empty.
Delete the test notification and confirm its removal.

bugs.name: FlashDuty notification saves successfully with its required Push URL left blank
bugs.summary: FlashDuty notification saves and persists with its visibly required Push URL blank.
bugs.expected: Because the Push URL field is visibly marked with an asterisk and “Required,” saving with it empty should be blocked and the form should remain open.
bugs.actual: After Save was clicked, the dialog closed and showed a green “Saved.” confirmation. The fresh notification appeared in the list with an Edit control; reopening it showed the Push URL still empty.
reproSteps: Start signed in as an admin using the provided saved session and open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and select FlashDuty (快猫星云).
Set Friendly Name to nt-inc-region-flashduty-repro-6f2c8a; leave the visibly required Push URL empty; keep Default enabled and Apply on all existing monitors unchecked.
Select Info severity and click Save.
Observe the success confirmation and the new notification entry with Edit in the list. Reopen that entry and verify its Push URL is still empty.

bugs.name: Telegram setup loses default Server URL and renders undefined getUpdates link after reopening
bugs.summary: Reopening an unsaved Telegram notification setup clears the documented default Server URL and renders the getUpdates helper link with an `undefined` host.
bugs.expected: When no custom Server URL is configured, the optional Server URL field and getUpdates helper link should use the documented default `https://api.telegram.org`.
bugs.actual: The first Telegram setup showed `https://api.telegram.org` in the Server URL field and as the helper link host. After entering a deliberately invalid placeholder token and Chat ID `0`, clicking Test, closing without saving, and reopening, the Server URL field was blank and the helper link displayed `undefined/bot<YOUR BOT TOKEN HERE>/getUpdates`. The defect remained visible after waiting five seconds.
reproSteps: Use the provided saved authentication state for the administrator account; no interactive credential values or environment variables were used.
Navigate to /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification with Telegram selected; observe `https://api.telegram.org` in the optional Server URL field and helper link.
Enter `not-a-real-token` in Bot Token and `0` in Chat ID. Leave Default enabled and Apply on all existing monitors off.
Click Test, then close the dialog with its close control without saving.
Reopen Set Up Notification with Telegram selected. Observe that Server URL is blank and the helper link begins `undefined/`; wait five seconds and confirm the state persists.

bugs.name: Push by Techulus saves notification channel containing underscores
bugs.summary: Push by Techulus saves and retains an underscore-containing Notification Channel despite the form stating that only alphanumeric characters and hyphens are allowed.
bugs.expected: The visible “Alphanumerical string and hyphens only” restriction should reject an underscore-containing Notification Channel and prevent saving that configuration.
bugs.actual: The setup accepted `exp_pushrest_tablet_k4n8`, closed with a green “Saved.” confirmation, and added the notification. Reopening the new notification showed the underscore-containing channel still saved alongside the helper text “Alphanumerical string and hyphens only.”
reproSteps: In the authorized admin session, load the provided authenticated state (no username/password environment variables or credentials were used), set a tablet-sized 1024×768 viewport, and open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and select Push by Techulus.

Enter Friendly Name `exp-pushrest-tablet-underscore-k4n8`, API Key `synthetic-nonworking-api-key-k4n8` (synthetic and non-working), and Notification Channel `exp_pushrest_tablet_k4n8`. Observe the helper text “Alphanumerical string and hyphens only.”
Keep Default enable on and Apply on all existing monitors off; do not assign the notification to a monitor. Click Save.

Verify the green “Saved.” confirmation and that `exp-pushrest-tablet-underscore-k4n8` appears in the notifications list. Reopen only this new fixture without making further changes and observe that `exp_pushrest_tablet_k4n8` remains saved despite the helper text.

bugs.name: Home Assistant Test with blank required fields shows runtime exception
bugs.summary: Testing a Home Assistant notification with both required connection fields blank consistently shows a raw undefined-property exception toast instead of actionable validation or a meaningful test outcome.
bugs.expected: With Home Assistant URL and Long-Lived Access Token marked required but left blank, Test should give a clear validation message or a meaningful test result, not expose a raw runtime exception.
bugs.actual: Clicking Test produced a distinct red toast reading “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')”. The same result appeared on a second click; the form stayed open and unsaved.
reproSteps: Open /settings/notifications in a fresh browser session and load the provided saved authentication state for the admin account; no credentials were entered.
Click Set Up Notification and choose Home Assistant as the notification type.
Leave the required Home Assistant URL and Long-Lived Access Token fields blank.
Scroll to the Test button and click Test; do not click Save.
Observe the red toast reading “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')”. The same toast was observed again after clicking Test a second time; the configuration remained unsaved.

reviewedVariants.name: Bark Test with its required endpoint blank produces an unhandled undefined-property error instead of input validation
reviewedVariants.summary: With Bark selected and Bark Endpoint left blank as marked required, clicking Test in the default setup repeatedly displayed an unhandled undefined-property error instead of useful validation.
reviewedVariants.expected: Because Bark Endpoint is visibly marked required, testing the incomplete form should give clear required-field validation or another actionable test error, not expose an unhandled JavaScript property error.
reviewedVariants.actual: Clicking Test displayed a red toast reading “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'endsWith')”. The toast appeared shortly after the click, remained visible for about five seconds, and recurred on an unchanged repeat. No field-level validation appeared.
reproSteps: In the authenticated admin session loaded from the supplied saved state, open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and select Bark.

Set Friendly Name to nt-push-bark-test. Leave Bark API Version at its initial blank value and Bark Endpoint blank (the UI marks Bark Endpoint with an asterisk). Enable Default enabled and leave Apply on all existing monitors unchecked; do not enter an endpoint, recipient, or credential.
Click Test. Observe the red “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'endsWith')” toast. Repeat Test without changing the fields and observe the same toast again.
Close the setup dialog without saving.

reviewedVariants.name: Google Chat Test with blank required Webhook URL shows internal argument-type error
reviewedVariants.summary: Testing Google Chat with the required Webhook URL blank repeatedly shows a raw ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE toast rather than identifying the missing field.
reviewedVariants.expected: With the required Webhook URL blank, Test should prevent the attempt and identify that the URL is required without displaying an internal runtime error.
reviewedVariants.actual: The Webhook URL remained blank and marked “* Required,” but clicking Test twice displayed a red toast: `The "url" argument must be of type string. Received undefined (code=ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE)`. No field-level validation appeared. The toast auto-dismissed after several seconds.
reproSteps: Start signed in as the authorized admin using the provided admin session.
Open /settings/notifications.
Click “Set Up Notification” and choose “Google Chat (Google Workspace)”.
Set Friendly Name to `nt-chat-one-google-repro-20260620-8471`; leave the required Webhook URL blank, enable “Default enabled,” and leave “Apply on all existing monitors” off.

Click “Test”. Observe the red toast: `The "url" argument must be of type string. Received undefined (code=ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE)`, with no field-level validation. Repeat Test with the same blank URL to confirm the result.

reviewedVariants.name: SMS.IR Test with blank configuration exposes a raw JavaScript exception
reviewedVariants.summary: Testing the SMS.IR setup with API Key, Recipient Numbers, and Template ID blank repeatedly shows a raw JavaScript TypeError toast instead of a usable test result.
reviewedVariants.expected: The Test action should provide user-facing validation or a meaningful test-failure result, rather than expose a JavaScript runtime exception.
reviewedVariants.actual: With all three SMS.IR configuration fields blank, clicking Test produced a red toast reading “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split')”; the notification setup dialog remained open. The same toast appeared again with Default enabled switched on and Apply on all existing monitors off.

Open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and select SMS.IR.
Leave API Key, Recipient Numbers, and Template ID blank; set Default enabled on and leave Apply on all existing monitors off.
Click Test and observe the new red toast. Repeat once with the same blank fields and toggle settings to confirm the result.

reviewedVariants.name: Alerta Test exposes an unhandled error when required fields are blank
reviewedVariants.summary: Testing an unsaved Alerta configuration with API Endpoint, Environment, and API Key blank displays an unhandled Node url-argument exception instead of a user-facing validation result; the setup dialog remains open and nothing is saved.
reviewedVariants.expected: Clicking Test with the required Alerta fields empty should return a user-facing validation result, not expose an unhandled server exception.
reviewedVariants.actual: The Test action displayed `The "url" argument must be of type string. Received undefined (code=ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE)` in a toast. The Alerta setup dialog remained open; Save was not clicked and no notification was saved.

Open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and select Alerta.
Leave API Endpoint, Environment, and API Key empty; leave both toggle settings unchanged.
Click Test. Observe the raw url/ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE toast and the still-open setup dialog; do not click Save.

reviewedVariants.name: Bark Test with empty Endpoint shows uncaught JavaScript error

reviewedVariants.actual: Clicking Test displayed a red toast: “Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'endsWith')”. The dialog remained open and unsaved; both Default enabled and Apply on all existing monitors stayed off.

reviewedVariants.name: Keep notification Test exposes undefined x-api-key header error when connection fields are blank
reviewedVariants.summary: Testing a new Keep notification with empty Host URL and API Key shows a raw undefined x-api-key header error instead of actionable missing-connection validation.
reviewedVariants.expected: With Host URL and API Key blank, Test should report the missing connection values in user-facing validation and should not expose an internal invalid-header error.
reviewedVariants.actual: Clicking Test repeatedly produced a red toast: `Invalid value "undefined" for header "x-api-key" (code=ERR_HTTP_INVALID_HEADER_VALUE)`. The modal remained open with both connection fields blank; Default enabled and Apply on all existing monitors remained off. The toast was visible in the reviewed browser video for about five seconds.
reproSteps: Load the provided saved admin session (signed-in admin; no additional credentials entered) and open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and select Keep.
Leave Host URL and API Key blank. Confirm Default enabled and Apply on all existing monitors are off; do not click Save.
Click Test and observe the toast. The modal remains open and the error says `Invalid value "undefined" for header "x-api-key" (code=ERR_HTTP_INVALID_HEADER_VALUE)`.

bugs.name: Webhook Save persists malformed headers and custom templates rejected by Test
bugs.summary: Webhook notification Save omits validation performed by Test, allowing malformed JSON headers or invalid custom Liquid templates to be persisted as unusable notification configurations.
bugs.expected: Save rejects syntactically invalid headers and custom templates and retains the editor with a clear validation message.
bugs.actual: Malformed headers save and persist; Test reports 'Additional Headers is not a valid JSON'. Invalid custom templates also save and persist despite Test reporting 'tag "invalid" not found, line:1, col:1'.
reproSteps: Sign in, open Settings > Notifications, and click Set Up Notification.
Select Webhook and enter a name and URL such as https://example.com/qa-settings.
Select the application/json Request Body Preset, enable Additional Headers, and enter {broken json.
Click Save, reopen using Edit, and click Test.

reviewedVariants.name: Webhook notification setup saves malformed Additional Headers JSON
reviewedVariants.summary: Webhook setup saved and retained malformed Additional Headers text without a validation message.
reviewedVariants.expected: The form says each additional header should be defined as a JSON key/value, so malformed input such as `not-json` should be rejected and not saved.
reviewedVariants.actual: Saving `not-json` closed the dialog and showed a green “Saved.” confirmation with no validation message. The notification appeared in the list and, after refresh, its Edit form still contained `not-json`.

bugs.name: Brevo saves a notification with malformed To Email

bugs.expected: The malformed To Email value should be identified as invalid and the setup should remain open without saving the configuration.
bugs.actual: Save closed the dialog and showed a Saved confirmation. The new fixture appeared in the notifications list, and after reloading, Edit reopened with `not-an-email` still in To Email. No validation was shown.
reproSteps: Using the administrator account, load the supplied saved-auth session, then open /settings/notifications.

Observe the Saved confirmation and fixture in the list. Reload the page, reopen the fixture, and observe that To Email still contains `not-an-email`.

bugs.name: AlertNow accepts and saves malformed webhook URL
bugs.summary: AlertNow accepts the malformed required Webhook URL `not-a-url`, closes the setup dialog with a Saved confirmation, and adds the configuration to the notification list; reopening it retains the malformed value.

bugs.actual: With `not-a-url` in the required Webhook URL field, Save closed the dialog, showed a green “Saved.” confirmation, and added the configuration to the list. Reopening its edit dialog showed `not-a-url` still saved.
reproSteps: Start signed in as the authorized administrator using the provided saved admin session; no credentials or environment variables were entered. Open /settings/notifications.
Click Set Up Notification and choose AlertNow as the Notification Type.
Enter the fresh Friendly Name `exp-alertnow-invalid-url-20260615-a91f`.
Enter `not-a-url` in the required Webhook URL field. Turn Default enabled on; leave Apply on all existing monitors off.
Click Save. Observe that the dialog closes, a “Saved.” confirmation appears, and the named AlertNow configuration is listed.
Open Edit for that configuration and verify that the Webhook URL still reads `not-a-url`. Do not assign it to any monitor.
After verification, delete only the fixture created for this reproduction.
